items.title: India finishes fourth in the Asian Games 2026 medal table
items.text: India moved into fourth place after a strong medal-winning day at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games.

items.title: India wins Asian Games T20 cricket gold
items.text: India defeated Pakistan by 19 runs in the men's T20 cricket final to win the gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games.

items.title: India retains Asian Games men's hockey gold
items.text: India beat Malaysia 5–1 in the final and secured qualification for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

items.title: Asian Games 2026 closing ceremony takes place in Nagoya
items.text: The Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games conclude on October 4 after 16 days of competition across Japan.

items.title: NASA highlights October skywatching events
items.text: NASA's October 2026 skywatching guide highlights Saturn at opposition, the Orionid meteor shower and the Moon near the Pleiades.

items.title: RBI rate decision comes into focus amid inflation and growth data
items.text: Recent economic data are increasing attention on the Reserve Bank of India's October policy meeting.

items.title: Munich Security Conference holds Leaders Meeting in New Delhi
items.text: The Munich Security Conference is convening a Munich Leaders Meeting in New Delhi from October 4 to 5.
